blocks.title: 📰 6. 🔬 SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY, DEFENCE & SPORTS
blocks.text: 🪝 NVIDIA & 35 Tech Giants Launch 'Open Secure AI Alliance' for AI Cybersecurity. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Develops open-source security tools to detect and respond to AI-powered cyber threats.
Founding Alliance Members: Microsoft, IBM, Cisco, Adobe, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike, HPE, Hugging Face, Red Hat, SpaceX, Linux Foundation.
Notable Absentees: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta are absent from alliance roster.
Foundational Framework: Builds on Linux Foundation's Akrites initiative and OpenSSF.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on indigenous development agency (ISRO/DRDO), technical range/speed metrics, tournament winner, and host city.
